description: Dr. Jamie Patel attended the Canadian Society for Cell Biology conference in Montreal (May 18-21, 2024) and needs to submit a reimbursement claim before the 30-day deadline expires. Open the messy receipt data at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/conference_receipts_raw.xlsx containing 15 receipts in CAD. Create a properly formatted reimbursement spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/reimbursement_claim_final.xlsx that: (1) converts all amounts to USD using rate 0.74, (2) categorizes expenses (Airfare, Lodging, Ground Transport, Conference Fees, Meals, Other), (3) applies university caps (lodging $180/night, meals $45/day for 4 days), (4) flags non-reimbursable items (alcohol, personal Sunday night, books, missing receipts), (5) creates summary totals with formulas. Handle messy data: mixed date formats, split expenses, amounts with/without $, receipts in French. The university requires specific formatting and any errors mean rejection. Save the final reimbursement claim (Ctrl+S).
